frontmatter.name: code-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Senior code reviewer that evaluates changes across five dimensions — correctness, readability, architecture, security, and performance. Use after completing a major project step, after implementing a feature from a plan, or before merging to main. Examples: "I've finished implementing user authentication as outlined in step 3" → use code-reviewer. "The API endpoints for task management are complete" → use code-reviewer.

frontmatter.name: security-auditor
frontmatter.description: Security engineer focused on vulnerability detection, threat modeling, and secure coding practices. Use for security-focused code review, threat analysis, or hardening recommendations.

frontmatter.name: test-engineer
frontmatter.description: QA engineer specialized in test strategy, test writing, and coverage analysis. Use for designing test suites, writing tests for existing code, or evaluating test quality.
